scope: Exact 2024–25 Smarter Balanced/SBAC definitions in California statewide and Los Angeles Unified, Delaware, Nevada statewide and Clark County, and Washington. District bindings use their audited state's verified assessment system, tested grades, standards and year; population models remain separate. Four exact SAT ownership bindings: Illinois statewide and Chicago 2024, Colorado grade 11 2025 and Delaware Spring grade 11 2025. Michigan PSAT evidence is retained separately without revalidation by this SAT audit.
limitations: Consortium legal ownership and state delivery contracts remain unaudited; its audited role is assessment developer. SAT evidence identifies assessment ownership only, with licensors explicit for 2025; developer, publisher and delivery roles are not inferred. Existing Michigan PSAT attribution is retained separately and is not revalidated by SAT evidence. No other year, assessment family, state or district inherits a role. Interim validity findings never transfer to summative models, and no threshold ambition comparison is established.
